newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU manufacturers show greater optimism in November.
newsitem.headline: EU manufacturers show greater optimism in November.

text.p: A majority of European Union (EU) manufacturers saw production rise in November, the first evidence of such a broad improvement since October 1995, the European Commission said on Tuesday.

"For the first time since October 1995, there is a majority of European manufacturing managers who saw their production augment in recent months," the Commission said in its latest survey of business and consumer confidence.
An improved outlook was also seen in the construction sector, where confidence rose for the third consecutive month, reaching its highest level of the year.
Optimism in both manufacturing and construction, however, was not evident among consumers whose level of confidence remained unchanged in comparision with the prior month.
Overall, the Commission's EU economic sentiment indicator, which incorporates the confidence indices in industry, construction and the consumer sector, posted a modest rise.
